identity.title: Lock source-neutral regression against producer coupling

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: After proving real EverRun regression, add only the minimum regression coverage needed to ensure equivalent projections from different producer identities yield identical governance deltas. This is a boundary lock, not a new comparison feature.
human_pressure.why_now: Real EverRun dogfood can accidentally tempt producer-specific fixes. The source-neutral property must be mechanically protected before the semantic surface is frozen.
do_not_misread: This does not assert arbitrary runs are comparable.
It only proves producer identity cannot change a delta when governance facts are otherwise identical.

machine_core.goal: Protect the existing governance comparator from source/producer identity coupling with deterministic tests and only minimal code repair if a coupling bug is reproduced.
red_lines: Do not compare unrelated factual states.
Do not add producer metadata to ranking.
Do not introduce a generic comparability model.
Do not change governance ranks unless required by 8067 evidence.
invariants: Changing only projection.source must not change any dimension transition.
Changing only run ids must not change dimension transitions.
Unknown and incomparable semantics remain unchanged.
No producer name appears in comparator decision logic.

producer.artifact: paired ExecutionProjection fixtures with identical governance facts and different source identities

observable_effect.assertion: Governance delta transitions are identical across producer identities when canonical governance facts are identical.

proofs.assertion: Focused tests explicitly vary source identity and assert identical transitions.

failure_semantics: If identity affects the transition, treat it as a source-neutrality regression.
Run identifiers remain output metadata but never ranking inputs.

steps.title: Add identity-variation coverage
details: Construct projections differing only by source identity and verify equal dimension transitions.
Repeat for differing run ids while facts remain equal.

steps.title: Inspect comparator for hidden producer coupling
details: Verify source/producer identity is never read for ranking or transition selection.

steps.title: Repair only if reproduced
details: If a test fails, remove the smallest identity coupling and retain existing semantics.

acceptance: Producer identity cannot alter governance transitions for identical canonical facts.
Run id differences do not alter dimension transitions.
No comparability framework or new governance concept is introduced.

must_check: 8067 completed or documented why no real comparable pair existed.
Tests vary only identity/run-id while preserving governance facts.
reject_if: Producer identity becomes an ordering or ranking input.
A new producer registry or comparability framework is introduced.
Tests alter governance facts while claiming an identity-only comparison.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Boundary regression for the already implemented source-neutral comparator.
